CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_verse_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `cached_verses` BEGIN INSERT INTO `verse_fts`(`docid`, `verse`, `translation`, `chapterNo`, `verseNo`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`verse`, NEW.`translation`, NEW.`chapterNo`, NEW.`verseNo`); END
